تحتجموا (form VIII)
# تَحْتَجِمُوا (taḥtajimū) /taħ.ta.d͡ʒi.muː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَجَمَ (iḥtajama)
# تُحْتَجَمُوا (tuḥtajamū) /tuħ.ta.d͡ʒa.muː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَجَمَ (iḥtajama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
